title: Adjustments 3: closing early
summary: The app's profit and time exits, when to close earlier yourself, and the habit that empties accounts.

questions.q: When does the app's profit exit close a group?
questions.why: Once 90% of the premium has decayed, the last 10% isn't worth the remaining risk.

questions.q: Why does the app close every leg with fewer than 7 days left?
options: Stock options settle by physical delivery and margins rise near expiry
questions.why: Physical delivery and rising margins make the last week risky for little reward.

questions.q: Results are announced before your expiry and you didn't plan for them. A sound move is:
options: Close the trade or add protection
questions.why: A results gap can jump past the stop; closing or protecting caps that risk.

options: Closing winners fast and holding losers
questions.why: Small wins and large held losses add up to a losing account.

questions.q: The weekly check for each open group asks:
options: Would I open this trade today, at these prices?
questions.why: If you wouldn't open it today, there's little reason to keep holding it.
